1.label: Group 1 — one-time curative treatment
1.mechanism: Financial support for treatment at notified Centres of Excellence (figures evolved from the original ₹20 lakh Group-1 ceiling).
1.caveat: Policy figures change. Verify current MoHFW / CoE guidance before relying on any amount.

2.label: Group 2 — long-term / lifelong lower-cost interventions
2.mechanism: NPRD envisages State Government support for dietary formulae, hormones, and other lower-cost interventions. This is a different route from the central CoE ₹50 lakh pathway; ask your state health department and a CoE which channel applies.
2.caveat: Central CoE funding may also apply depending on current rules — confirm with a notified Centre of Excellence. Do not assume the ₹50 lakh ceiling covers Group 2 by default.

3.label: Group 3 — high-cost / lifelong therapy with careful selection
3.mechanism: Financial support at notified Centres of Excellence is the figure commonly cited in recent MoHFW/PIB statements. Many Group 3 patients also use the MoHFW voluntary-contribution / crowdfunding portal.
3.caveat: Eligibility and patient selection rules change. Verify with a CoE; the crowdfunding portal is a separate mechanism from CoE funding.
